description: List models in a project by slug, owner/slug, or project ul:// URI. Model quality is not included; use model_metrics, which validates the platform's best-epoch fields.

limit.description: Maximum models to return. Omit for the server default (currently 20); the API currently accepts up to 100.

project.description: Project ref by slug, owner/slug, or ul:// URI.

name: models_list
